verses.original: מֶה־ עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא־ כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא־ עֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: meh- ‘ā·zar·tā lə·lō- ḵō·aḥ hō·wō·ša‘·tā zə·rō·w·a‘ lō- ‘ōz
verses.literal: How you have helped the powerless . . . and saved the arm that is feeble . . .
verses.literalPt: Como sabes ajudar ao que não tem poder! Como prestar socorro ao braço que não tem força!

verses.original: מַה־ יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yā·‘aṣ·tā lə·lō ḥāḵ·māh wə·ṯū·šî·yāh lā·rōḇ hō·w·ḏā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: How you have counseled the unwise . . . and provided fully sound insight
verses.literalPt: Que bons conselhos dás ao que não tem sabedoria e em quão grande cópia revelas o verdadeiro conhecimento!

verses.original: אֶת־ מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת־ מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mî hig·gaḏ·tā mil·lîn wə·niš·maṯ- mî yā·ṣə·’āh mim·me·kā
verses.literal: To whom have you uttered these words And whose spirit spoke through you
verses.literalPt: A quem diriges palavras? E de quem é o espírito que fala em ti?

verses.literal: The dead tremble those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them
verses.literalPt: Tremem debaixo das águas os manes e os que ali habitam.

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: Sheol is naked before God and Abaddon has no covering
verses.literalPt: O Sheol está nu diante dele, e Abadom não tem o que lhe cubra.

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל־ תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל־ בְּלִי־ מָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṭeh ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘al- tō·hū tō·leh ’e·reṣ ‘al- bə·lî- māh
verses.literal: He stretches out the north over empty space He hangs the earth upon nothing . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele estende o norte sobre o vácuo e suspende a terra sobre o nada.

verses.original: צֹרֵֽר־ מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא־ נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·rêr- ma·yim bə·‘ā·ḇāw wə·lō- niḇ·qa‘ ‘ā·nān taḥ·tām
verses.literal: He wraps up the waters in His clouds yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight
verses.literalPt: Encerra as águas nas suas nuvens grossas e com elas não se rasga a nuvem.

verses.original: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי־ כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: He covers the face of the full moon spreading over it His cloud
verses.literalPt: Encobre a face do seu trono e sobre ele estende a sua nuvem.

verses.original: חֹֽק־ חָ֭ג עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מָ֑יִם עַד־ תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥōq- ḥāḡ ‘al- pə·nê- mā·yim ‘aḏ- taḵ·lîṯ ’ō·wr ‘im- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness
verses.literalPt: Descreve um limite circular sobre a superfície das águas, onde a luz e as trevas se confinam.

verses.literal: The foundations of heaven quake astounded at His rebuke
verses.literalPt: As colunas do céu tremem E se espantam das suas ameaças.

verses.original: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם וּבִתוּבְנָתוֹ מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵō·ḥōw rā·ḡa‘ hay·yām ū·ḇi·ṯū·ḇə·nå̄·ṯō mā·ḥaṣ rā·haḇ
verses.literal: By His power He stirred the sea by His understanding He shattered Rahab
verses.literalPt: Com o seu poder, agita o mar e, pelo seu entendimento, traspassa a Raabe.

verses.original: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rū·ḥōw šā·ma·yim šip̄·rāh ḥō·lă·lāh yā·ḏōw nā·ḥāš bā·rî·aḥ
verses.literal: By His breath the skies were cleared His hand pierced the fleeing serpent
verses.literalPt: Pelo seu sopro, os céus são embelezados, a sua mão fere a serpente veloz.

verses.original: הֶן־ אֵ֤לֶּה׀ קְצ֬וֹת דַּרְכּוֹ וּמַה־ שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע־ בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גְּבוּרָתוֹ מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: hen- ’êl·leh qə·ṣō·wṯ dar·kō ū·mah- šê·meṣ dā·ḇār niš·ma‘- bōw wə·ra·‘am gə·ḇū·rå̄·ṯō mî yiṯ·bō·w·nān
verses.literal: Indeed these are but the fringes of His ways how faint is the whisper we hear of Him Who then can understand the thunder of His power
verses.literalPt: Eis que essas coisas são somente as bordas dos seus caminhos. Quão pequeno é o sussurro que dele ouvimos! Porém o trovão dos seus grandes feitos, quem o poderá entender?
